prompt:
Image 1 is a pixel-art sprite sheet of the lower bodies of two small chibi characters for a top-down 2D game, in 2 rows and 3 columns. Column 1 faces the viewer, column 2 faces right, column 3 faces away from the viewer. Redraw this sheet exactly, with the same layout, the same 6 figures in the same positions, the same size, the same pixel-art style and the same flat solid pure magenta background, RGB 255,0,255. Do not move, resize or redraw the legs. Every knee and boot stays on exactly the same pixels as in Image 1.

Change only one thing: remove everything worn around the waist and the arms. Remove the belt, the skirt or waist guard, the arms, the hands and the gloves. Draw what was hidden behind them: plain tight dark trousers that cover the hips and the thighs up to the waist, in a very dark neutral colour. The top edge of each figure is a straight waist line at the height of the belt.

Keep only the plain dark hips, the thighs, the knees and the boots.

Do not include: a belt, a skirt, a waist guard, arms, hands, a torso, a head, weapons, shields, text, labels, numbers, grid lines, ground, shadows, dust, effects, borders, watermark, or any other object. No soft gradients, blur or painterly rendering.
